task: Acted on the 2026-07-10 Voices/VoiceLab test-value audit (design-docs/plans/active/final_release/audits/test_value_audit_2026-07-10_voices.md): deleted all 11 DEFINITE low-value tests and made a fix-or-delete call on each of the 8 DISCUSS items, defaulting to fixing over deleting where a real scenario was worth protecting. Test-only change; no production source files touched.

frontend/tests/unit/pages/VoiceLab/Sampl.summary: Deleted 'renders the Samples section label' and 'renders the SampleManager component (expand/collapse button present)' — both static-presence tests fully subsumed by sibling tests in the same file (audit DEFINITE).

frontend/tests/unit/pages/VoiceLab/TestS.summary: Deleted 'renders the Test section label' and 'renders the Generate test button' (audit DEFINITE, static presence). Strengthened the DISCUSS variant-selector test: it now asserts the full interpolated option label 'Default (XTTS v2)' instead of a loose /default/i substring match, so a regression in either the variant_name or the engine display_name lookup is caught. Left 'renders the engine badge' as-is — it already asserts a real computed lookup value, not a literal.

frontend/tests/unit/pages/VoiceLab/Varia.summary: Deleted 'renders the Variants section label' and 'renders an Add variant button' (audit DEFINITE, static presence). Fixed the DISCUSS 'renders VariantEditor rows for each profile' test: replaced the vague `playButtons.length > 2` assertion with an exact count of the one unconditional 'Script' button VariantEditor renders per profile (`toHaveLength(2)`), so a bug that drops one row is now caught.

frontend/tests/unit/pages/VoiceLab/Voice.summary: Deleted 'renders the copy icon prompt button' and 'renders the upload icon button' (audit DEFINITE, static presence). Replaced the upload static-presence test with a real upload-interaction test: fires a file through the hidden `aria-label="Upload voice icon file"` input via userEvent.upload and asserts `api.uploadVoiceIcon` is called with the file and `onIconUploaded` fires with the returned image path — closing the coverage gap the audit flagged (no test anywhere previously exercised the actual upload flow).

frontend/tests/unit/pages/Voices/compone.summary: Deleted the 'VoicePillRow dark theme smoke > renders without error in dark theme' test (audit DEFINITE) — confirmed no cheap real dark-theme-specific assertion is feasible: VoicePills styling is driven entirely by CSS custom properties resolved by the real stylesheet, and vitest.config.ts has no `css: true`, so jsdom never computes real theme colors here.

Replaced the zero-assertion 'handles resizing' test (audit DEFINITE) with a real test: mousedown on the resize handle (found via `getByRole('separator', {name: 'Resize drawer'})` since the Drawer portals to document.body, not the render container — this is why the old `container.querySelector` lookup silently returned null and made every assertion unreachable), mousemove to a known clientX, assert the dialog's inline width matches `window.innerWidth - clientX`, then mouseup and assert further mousemove no longer resizes it. R1 revert-checked: temporarily neutered `setWidth(newWidth)` in VoiceUtils.tsx, confirmed the new test fails for the right reason (width stayed at the initial 800px), then restored via `git checkout`. Also fixed the DISCUSS 'renders when open and handles close' test to use `getByRole('button', {name: 'Close'})` instead of the fragile `buttons.find(b => b.innerHTML.includes('svg'))` heuristic.

Deleted the ScriptEditor 'keeps custom imported base variant labels editable' test (audit DEFINITE true duplicate — ScriptEditor's variant-name input has no logic that varies by variantName value). Trimmed the DISCUSS MoveVariantModal test: removed the open-dropdown/select-option steps that duplicate MoveVariantSearchableSelect.test.tsx's dedicated coverage, keeping only the one thing that file doesn't cover — clicking 'Move Variant' and asserting onSubmit fires.

frontend/tests/unit/pages/VoiceLab/Voice.summary: Deleted 'renders the phase stepper with 4 steps' (DISCUSS, resolved to delete — PhaseStepper's STEPS array is a hardcoded literal with no data-driven branch, and the adjacent 'marks the Ready step as active' test already exercises the real phase-computation logic). Fixed 'renders the back link to /voices' (DISCUSS) into a real navigation test: clicks the back button and asserts the /voices route (`voices-page` test id) actually renders, rather than only checking the button exists. Left 'renders section placeholders (samples, variants, test)' as-is per the audit's own conclusion — a legitimate, narrow wiring tripwire against accidentally dropping a whole section.

flow_impact: Test-only change across 8 files under frontend/tests/unit/pages/{Voices,VoiceLab}/ — no production source, contracts, or specs touched.
